instruction: Press down on the blue stapler with smooth finish with the right arm.

source.instruction: Press down on the blue stapler with smooth finish with the right arm.

arm_note: ARM CHOICE in this demonstration: the RIGHT arm grasped the stapler, which was at x = +1 (right half of the table). The arm was chosen by the object's x position (x < 0 -> LEFT arm, x > 0 -> RIGHT arm; each arm reaches only ~15 cm past the centre line). In YOUR scene the objects may be on the other side: choose the arm from your own object positions, not from the demonstration.

frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.93; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.93; table z = 74
frames.plan: Rotate right arm roll and yaw to match the stapler orientation, move left to x = 15.5 cm and lower to z = 89 cm.
